concept.material: speckled green nephrite jade and rose gold
concept.internal_detail: interlocking concentric brass rings and fine escapement springs
concept.button: a miniature round rose-gold rivet set into the cleft
concept.shell_mechanic: The jade heart divides along its central fissure and swings open like paired wing shields
concept.emerging_parts: A long needle-thin proboscis beak, fan-shaped slotted tail feathers, and two delicate latticed foil wings
concept.signature_move: its gold-latticed wings flutter once in a high-speed mechanical blur and lock rigid with an audible click
concept.turkish: Geniş kuyruklu sinek kuşu (ufak nektar emen kuş) — yassı kalp şeklinde plaka, benekli yeşil nefrit yeşimi ve pembe altın

concept.material: weathered sheet copper and oiled teak
concept.internal_detail: miniature brass pulley wheels and wound wire cables
concept.button: a small knurled copper screw-head recessed near the prow
concept.shell_mechanic: The ribbed hull plates flex outward on miniature copper leaf springs
concept.emerging_parts: A blunt teak head with pin-hole optics, two elongated paddle flippers, and two short rear steering vanes
concept.signature_move: its broad front paddles sweep downward in a deliberate synchronized rowing arc and lock back in rest position
concept.turkish: Deri sırtlı deniz kaplumbağası (büyük okyanus kaplumbağası) — yivli tekne gövdesi, eskitilmiş bakır ve yağlı tik ağacı
